summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. (Nu) filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Rob Livingston as CFO effective July 13, replacing Guilherme Lago who transitions to Special Advisor through August 31. This is a planned, orderly succession with no change to operating model or strategy; Livingston brings 30+ years from Visa. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a routine management transition under Rule 13a-16, mapping to a US current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. What to watch: shareholder reaction to the new CFO's strategic direction; no risk-arb angle.
